ai_summary: The Anup Engineering Limited has acquired a 10% stake in Arvind Global Capability Center Private Limited (Arvind GCC) for a nominal sum, a newly incorporated entity (April 2026) with no prior operational history or turnover. The acquisition aims to establish a centralized hub for business support and shared services across group entities, potentially impacting future operational efficiencies. A key red flag is that this is a related party transaction with promoter interest, which, despite being conducted at arm's length and based on independent valuation, warrants careful monitoring.
